_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s16b-gates-cannot-be-unset.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 6).

features.description: Every tool in BUILTIN_TOOLS is classified as write-capable or read-only, and adding one to neither turns the suite red.
Every write-capable builtin ships with requires_confirmation set in code.
Every write-capable builtin's Flow Tool row requires confirmation after the sync a migrate runs.
The runtime tool resolved from each of those rows requires confirmation.
Saving one of those rows with the gate unchecked is refused with a message naming the tool.
The refusal holds on insert as well as on save, and for a caller passing ignore_permissions.
A read-only builtin's row can still be saved ungated, so the refusal is not refusing everything.
A row whose gate was turned off before this fix is restored by sync_builtin_tools.
A new Script tool is created with requires_confirmation set.
An author who deliberately unchecks the gate on their own Script tool still can.
The registry test fails when a write-capable builtin's row is unchecked, demonstrated in-process and rolled back.
The registry test cannot pass vacuously: a control proves the registry is not empty and another proves the flag is not True for every tool.
No text this change puts in front of a model or a person names the platform, a vendor or a model.
